description: Microbiology request: colony count (MII KDS Mikrobiologie 2027, profile MII_PR_Mikrobio_Keimzahl, ValueSet MII_VS_Mikrobio_Keimzahl_LOINC). None of the four enumerated module codes (49223-1, 564-5, 38436-2, 699-9) is in the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21, so the ECL can only show the neighbourhood: number concentrations of organisms (e.g. 485861010000102 'Number concentration of bacteria in urine'). The organism is the Component for counts.

queries.name: Colony count — number concentration of an organism
queries.description: Number concentration or logarithmic number concentration where the counted entity is an organism (Component or Inheres in).
queries.ecl: << 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = (118550005 |Number concentration (property) (qualifier value)| OR 705056007 |Logarithmic number concentration (property) (qualifier value)|), (246093002 |Component (attribute)| = << 410607006 |Organism (organism)| OR 704319004 |Inheres in (attribute)| = << 410607006 |Organism (organism)|)

queries.name: Colony count — with culture technique asserted
